The '''Empress Teta system''' or '''Teta system''', named for [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]],<ref name="DE endnotes" /> contained the planet of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] (formerly Koros Major). It was formerly known as the '''Koros system''', with Koros Major colonized by [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscanti]] explorers on [[Generation ship/Legends|generation ships]].<ref name="TEA" /> One of the places in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] where [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] could be found, its discovery brought up the technology of [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]].

By the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the system's many conquests had left it prosperous and powerful, but also bloated, over-stretched and corrupt.

Concurrent with the rise of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] as [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]],<ref name="DLotS6" /> the capital city of Empress Teta, [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], fell under the influence of a cult devoted to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] known as the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]]. Led by the spoiled nobleman [[Satal Keto/Legends|Satal Keto]] and his cousin [[Aleema Keto|Aleema]], they murdered their parents and instigated a [[Krath Holy Crusade|fierce civil war]],<ref name="DLotS1" /> clashing with interventionist forces from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="DLotS2" /> and opportunistic [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] eager to make the system the target of a new crusade.<ref name="TSW1" />

The [[Tedryn Holocron]] mentioned the Empress Teta System to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] when telling her about [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]].<ref name="DE endnotes" />
